title: Hide and Seek
description: During their usual game of hide-and-seek, Pa finds Kid-3 giggling under the table. She still declares herself the winner.
alt: In a cozy living room, Pa kneels beside a table and lifts the tablecloth to find Kid-3 giggling underneath. She raises a triumphant fist and says, “I win!” Pa smiles and says he can hear her laughing under the table.
